# IsoGraph

> Public source index for LLMs and software agents. Read-only access requires no GitHub authentication.

## Primary entry points

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/main/README.md): project overview and documentation entry point.
- [EVIDENCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/main/EVIDENCE.md): evidence classes, claim scope, validation limits, and external-validation path.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/main/AGENTS.md): repository-specific agent instructions and authority rules.
- [Agent access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/main/.agent/ACCESS.md): anonymous access routes and precedence notes.
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/main/LICENSE): license terms.

## Evidence status

- Evidence registry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/main/EVIDENCE.md
- Machine claims: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/main/evidence/claims.json
- Current Core/module qualification is **INTERNAL-QUALIFICATION**. Cold/fresh/different-model or provider isolation improves execution independence but does not itself create external authority.
- No general independent external validation of IsoGraph's formal/structural claims is currently registered.

## Anonymous source access

- Repository: https://github.com/iteathen/IsoGraph
- Git clone: `https://github.com/iteathen/IsoGraph.git`
- Raw files: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/main/
- ZIP snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/zip/refs/heads/main
- tar.gz snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/IsoGraph/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

Prefer Git, raw HTTPS, or codeload over the GitHub REST API when possible. Follow repository-local authority and agent instructions.
